node.statement: By validated node 1.2, Co_Q(X^dagger X)=X^dagger dot X=h*u_Q. Hence the preceding bound is ||h*u_Q-X^dagger X|| <= C_rc*e*r^2. Since h>=0, a=||u_Q||, and b=||X^dagger X||, absolute homogeneity and the reverse triangle inequality give abs(h*a-b)=abs(||h*u_Q||-||X^dagger X||)<=||h*u_Q-X^dagger X||<=C_rc*e*r^2.
